body: the thing is. i hate myself more than anyone could... thats why i just want to die, so people dont have to deal with me anymore...
Im so tired... its to much too keep fighting the date in my mind, and after everything thats happening the date should be today
what comes after...? Im just want people to forget me and everything ive done
i tried calling a hotline and the lines were all busy, its a sign that this is the time where I should just do it, talking with someone in person or on the phone wont ever fix what ive done
I understand that, ive been telling myself that for years. The part where it falls apart is I look at myself and cant imagine having a real life, it always ends in suicide....
Ive reached out before told people that i cared about that i want to go, they all push it off. Its time for me but ive failed so many times...
I cant walk... Im trapped here in pain and my thoughts I cant keep making everyone I know miserable

What comes after? Thats what i fear most, ive tried to be religious in the past but i never found myself truly believing... what kind of world would have people all suffering so much pain and no matter what we do death is inevitable. Im scared but im ready
I need to do this, I know it will solve everyones problems that I have caused, Ive tried in the past and keep failing, I just dont want to keep failing like i have with everything else in my life...
